-- ============================================================
-- test-05-generics_pos.fh  –  Generics PASS-Tests (GEN-01..07)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Generics.Pos

import Test.Support exposing NotFound

type SimpleColor is record
    red:   Integer
    green: Integer
    blue:  Integer
end record

error DbError

function make_color(r: Integer, g: Integer, b: Integer) returns SimpleColor
requires r >= 0, g >= 0, b >= 0
ensures result.red = r
is
    return SimpleColor { red: r, green: g, blue: b }
end make_color

-- GEN-01: Result<T, E>
function find_color(id: Integer) returns Result<SimpleColor, DbError>
requires id > 0
aborts DbError when id > 999
ensures success, value.red >= 0
is
    if id > 999 then
        abort DbError
    end if
    return ok make_color(id, 0, 0)
end find_color

-- GEN-02: Array<T, N>
function make_palette() returns Array<SimpleColor, 3>
ensures value[0].red >= 0
is
    let c0: SimpleColor = make_color(255, 0, 0)
    let c1: SimpleColor = make_color(0, 255, 0)
    let c2: SimpleColor = make_color(0, 0, 255)
    return [c0, c1, c2]
end make_palette

-- GEN-02 EDGE: Size=1 Array
function singleton_array() returns Array<Integer, 1>
ensures value[0] >= 0
is
    return [42]
end singleton_array

-- GEN-03: Result<Array<T,N>, E>
function load_palette() returns Result<Array<SimpleColor, 3>, DbError>
ensures success, value[0].red >= 0
is
    let arr: Array<SimpleColor, 3> = make_palette()
    return ok arr
end load_palette

-- GEN-06: Generische Funktion
function wrap_value<T>(amount: Integer) returns Integer
requires amount >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return amount
end wrap_value

-- GEN-07: Instanziierung generischer Funktion
procedure use_generic()
is
    let n: Integer = wrap_value<Integer>(10)
    call Std.IO.logf("wrapped = ${}", n)
end use_generic

end Test.Generics.Pos
